meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你给的讲话视频转成带设计卡片的版本:先提取音频和转录,再根据说话内容生成定时出现的标题、底部信息条、数据标注等图形,最后渲染成一个新 MP4。原视频不会被改动。
howto.when: 当你说出“图形叠加”、“屏幕图形”、“包装视频”等关键词,或要求给已有讲解视频加图形卡片时触发。纯字幕需求不会触发,不确定时会建议改用 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给我的采访视频加上图文叠加卡片,和说话内容同步
say.note: 会生成带定时卡片的新 MP4

say.text: 把这个播客视频包装一下,设计下三分和引言卡片
在视频上叠加数据标注和动态标题,保持原视频不变

howto.what_en: Claude packages your talking-head clip with designed, transcript-synced graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, PiP) and renders a new MP4; the original video plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', 'package/dress up my video', or ask to add designed cards to an existing talking-head video. Plain subtitles won't trigger it; if unsure it defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlay cards to my interview video, synced to the speech.
say_en.note: Produces a new MP4 with timed cards.

say_en.text: Dress up this podcast video with lower-thirds and quote cards.
Overlay data callouts and kinetic titles; keep the original video as-is.
